items.title: Do NOT Swim in This Pool.. (Pool Loop)
items.description:
Today, I'm playing Pool Loop, a creepy new anomaly horror game where you have to spot the distortions before it's too late. It is just as unsettling as it sounds.

You are stuck in a weird pool area with a single exit and a lap counter, and you need to inspect every inch to decide if it is clear or dangerous. One wrong move and things get ugly fast.

This spooky game keeps you on edge because you never know what is going to change next. The horror gameplay is all about paying attention to detail
